Build a growth strategy your team can use

Growth planning starts with a choice about which customers to serve and what the business can deliver reliably as demand increases.

In this guide
Look at recent customersChoose a testReview the whole journey

Look at recent customers

Review a handful of profitable jobs. Identify the customer’s original problem, where the enquiry came from and the part of your offer they valued.

Choose a test

Pick one customer group and one route to reach it. Work out the capacity, budget and response time you can commit to a small trial.

Review the whole journey

Count relevant enquiries, accepted quotations and completed jobs. Review margin and delivery time alongside sales. A busy team can still be taking on the wrong kind of work.
